description: Create, overwrite or partially edit a text file in the project: .yaml/.yml (e.g. scenarios), .json, .md, .txt, .csv. Give 'content' for the whole file or 'edits' (exact replacements, like script_edit). YAML syntax is checked before writing and scenario files are validated (warnings); JSON must parse. Undoable with edit_undo. Use script_write for .gd files.

dry_run.description: Preview only: validate and return the diff without writing.

edits.description: Exact text replacements applied in order to the existing file.

name: file_write
title: Write text file
